pages.text: Cast your first spell on day one. Two systems have a Tier 1 entry path: Iron's Spellbooks (pre-rolled scrolls and spell books) and Ars Nouveau (glyph-based spell crafting). This entry takes you from loot to first cast in both.

pages.title: Iron's Scrolls
pages.text: $(bold)Scrolls$() are one-shot items, each holding a single random, pre-rolled spell. Find them in village chests and Overworld loot chests (~2-3% per chest).$(br2)If your class is $(bold)Archmage$(), $(bold)Battlemage$(), or $(bold)Void Summoner$(), your starter kit comes with two scrolls of basic spells (magic missile, firebolt, magic arrow, fang strike, or summon vex, depending on class).

pages.title: Iron's Spell Books
pages.text: $(bold)Copper spell books$() drop from Overworld chests (~3%). You can inscribe one with spells you've learned by reading scrolls, and from then on it is a reusable caster. Iron, Gold, Diamond, and Netherite books come in later tiers for higher-tier spells.$(br2)Inscribing a spell takes $(bold)Common ink$() (~5% Overworld) and blank runes.

pages.title: Starting Ars Nouveau
pages.text: You can craft Ars's $(bold)novice spell book$() on the vanilla workbench at T1 from one $(item)Book$() and four iron tools ($(item)iron shovel$(), $(item)iron pickaxe$(), $(item)iron axe$(), $(item)iron sword$()). The Imbuement Chamber and deep source network come later; this first step is open from the start.
Shapeless workbench recipe: a book plus one of each iron tool.$(br2)Hold it in your main hand and right-click to cast; press $(k:ars_nouveau.open_book) to open the spell editor.

pages.title: Glyphs & Inscribing
pages.text: An Ars spell book is a blank caster until you inscribe $(bold)glyphs$() into it at a $(item)Scribes Table$(). Glyphs come from chest loot (T1 glyphs are front-loaded into Overworld chests) and from research papers.$(br2)A working T1 spell needs at least one $(bold)form$() (projectile, touch, self, aoe) and one $(bold)effect$() (harm, break, light, and so on). Inscribe both at the Scribes Table and the book can cast.

pages.title: Casting
pages.text: $(bold)Iron's Spellbooks:$() right-click to cast the scroll or spell book, or use $(k:irons_spellbooks.spellbook_cast) or the $(k:irons_spellbooks.spell_wheel) spell wheel. A scroll is used up when you cast it; a spell book costs mana and can be recast.$(br2)$(bold)Ars Nouveau:$() right-click the inscribed spell book. The glyphs run in order, with the form applying the effect.

pages.title: Mana vs Source
pages.text: Iron's uses $(bold)Mana$() (the blue bar); Ars uses $(bold)Source$() (a server-side pool). Both regenerate on their own, and T2 unlocks faster regen and higher caps.

pages.title: Mana vs Source, cont.
pages.text: $(bold)Mana pool baseline:$() the magic classes have bigger pools: $(item)2.5x$() for the Archmage, $(item)2x$() for the Elemental, the Blessed and the Corrupted, $(item)1.9x$() for the Battlemage and the Void Summoner. Non-mage classes use the base ISS pool, and speccing into a magic class is the way to expand it.$(br2)$(bold)Next: upgrade your caster with $(l:icraft:mods_t1/modular_spells)Modular Spell Books$(/l).$()
